memoryBuilder.verseText: For with God nothing shall be impossible.

sequence.prompt: What happened when the angel visited Mary? Put it in order.

items.label: Angel announces she will have God's Son
Mary asks: How is this possible?

matches.prompt: Match each to what they did.

pairs.right: Said yes to God even though it was hard

application.question: Mary said yes to God even when it was hard and surprising. What is one thing God might be asking YOU to say yes to?
application.followUp: Mary didn't know how, but she trusted God enough to say yes. When you say yes to God, He makes a way — even when you can't see how.
